title.zh: IEC 认证：德国 GER-01 队调整为中型

summary.en: The Technisches Hilfswerk (THW) Schnell Einsatz Einheit Bergung Ausland (SEEBA) Team (GER-01) has been successfully reclassified from Heavy to Medium USAR team following the classification process conducted from 5 to 9 October 2026 in Austria. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
summary.zh: 德国联邦技术救援署（THW）海外快速救援分队（SEEBA，GER-01）于2026年10月5日至9日在奥地利完成分级认证，由重型队调整为中型城市搜索与救援队。

content.en: The Technisches Hilfswerk (THW) Schnell Einsatz Einheit Bergung Ausland (SEEBA) Team (GER-01) has been successfully reclassified from Heavy to Medium USAR team following the classification process conducted from 5 to 9 October 2026 in Austria. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
content.zh: 德国联邦技术救援署（Technisches Hilfswerk，THW）海外快速救援分队（Schnell Einsatz Einheit Bergung Ausland，SEEBA，编号 GER-01）于2026年10月5日至9日在奥地利境内完成分级认证，由重型队调整为中型城市搜索与救援队。INSARAG 秘书处向该队致以最诚挚的祝贺。
